newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Asian Props to return funds with buyback.
newsitem.headline: Asian Props to return funds with buyback.

text.p: Asian Properties said on Friday it would return capital to investors through a share buyback at NZ$1.45 a share following the sale of its interests in President Hotel Sdn Bhd.
The sale, due to completed on June 20, should result in cash reserves totalling NZ$94 million.
The company had tried to return capital previously but had failed to obtain permission from the Isle of Man High Court.
Since 1993, various shareholders had asked the board to sponsor another capital reduction proposal, which it will put to an extraordinary meeting next month.
The company will pay NZ$1.45 for each share cancelled and all shares will be cancelled.
The reduction and the return of capital will be conditional on the completion of the sale of the group's interests in the hotel, and Isle of Man High Court approval.
Cancellation is planned for August 4 and a payment date is yet to be announced.
Hetherington, which has an 18 percent interest in the company, had indicated it would support the the reduction.
Participation by Hetherington would bring to an end all claims, disputes and litigation between Hetherington, the company and its directors.
Asian Properties said the reduction may lead to the delisting of the company because it may not satisfy the minimum spread requirements.
The Board would therefore propose a second resolution to require the company to seek delisting if the number of shareholders fell below 75.
